channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Erdoğan: Türkiye now in 'different league' in health care
item.description: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan said on Dec. 26 that Türkiye has entered a "different league" in global health care, asserting that his administration’s reforms have standardized high-quality medical access for all citizens.

item.title: A cheese story stretching from Urfa to America
item.description: A story that began in a tent found its direction through vision. Today, the cheese, yogurt and clarified butter produced by Urfarm from the native İvesi sheep breed have reached dining tables across the United States

item.title: Christian communities across Türkiye embrace spirit of Christmas
item.description: From the historic cathedrals of Istanbul to the stone-carved sanctuaries of the southeastern province of Mardin, Christian communities across the country have united this week to mark Christmas with a range of festive celebrations.

item.title: Pashinyan urges ‘more concrete’ steps in Türkiye normalization
item.description: Ankara and Yerevan should move their normalization process into a new phase, Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan has said, urging the sides to take more tangible steps.

item.title: Türkiye says prevailing situation in Yemen 'source of concern'
item.description: Türkiye on Friday said that "the prevailing situation" in Yemen is a "source of concern."

item.title: Thailand and Cambodia agree to 'immediate' ceasefire: joint statement
item.description: Thailand and Cambodia agreed to an "immediate" ceasefire on Saturday, the two countries said in a joint statement, pledging to end weeks of deadly border clashes.

item.title: Deadly blast hits mosque in Alawite area of Syria's Homs
item.description: An explosion killed at least eight worshippers at a mosque in a predominantly Alawite area of Syria's Homs on Friday, state media said, with an extremist group claiming responsibility.

item.title: Russia lashes out at Zelensky ahead of new Trump talks on Ukraine plan
item.description: Volodymyr Zelensky is due to meet President Donald Trump in Florida this weekend, but Russia accused the Ukrainian president and his EU backers Friday of seeking to "torpedo" a U.S.-brokered plan to stop the fighting.

item.title: Türkiye says Israeli move to recognize Somaliland 'violation of international law'
item.description: Türkiye’s Communications Director Burhanettin Duran on Friday denounced Israel’s announcement recognizing the Somaliland region as an independent state, calling the move “a clear violation of international law.”

item.title: Türkiye holds funeral ceremony for Libyan military delegation killed in Ankara plane crash
item.description: Türkiye held a ceremony in the capital Ankara on Saturday before the bodies of members of a Libyan military delegation, including Chief of General Staff Gen. Mohammed Ali Al-Haddad, who were killed in a plane crash, were repatriated to Libya.
